The Washington Wizards upgraded the rookie to available for the road matchup with the Cleveland Cavaliers after he went through morning shootaround. The Wizards announced AJ Dybantsa is available, and they backed it with a hype video built around his No. 4 jersey. The status moved fast. He was listed as questionable on Tuesday night, the first time this season he carried that tag. Washington has played four games without its top pick, so his return matters.How did Dybantsa get hurt?The 19-year-old landed awkwardly in the second quarter of the preseason finale against the Pelicans on October 16 and could not finish.
